findings.source_quote: We are Thine, do Thou befriend us,
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the plea literally and simply to preserve the original sense: "نحن لك، فاصحبنا" or "نحن لك، فارافقنا" (recommended: "نحن لك، فاصحبنا"). Do not add notions such as "فارحمنا وتآزر معنا" which introduce extra petitions not present in the source.
Title is acceptable but consider a slightly more idiomatic Arabic rendering such as "وعد ترنيمة" is fine; no change required unless editor prefers "وعد أغنية".
